ambient_events: This stretch is clean. No drifts, no bones, no nests in the pipe mouths. Something keeps it that way.
A wire has been strung ankle-high across the pipe mouth and tied off with a bell that is not there any more.
Two notes of a whistle come down the tunnel, unhurried, and are not repeated.
description: The tunnel beneath Kessler Street carries the quiet waste of the blocks above: grey water, lost things, the occasional startled scurry at the edge of your light.
name: Drain Junction
